subject: McGlynn School Solar Panel Contract
overview: The Committee of the Whole discussed a request to authorize a 20-year solar power purchase agreement for the McGlynn School roof. The committee referred the matter to the regular City Council meeting.

items.title: Authorization of 20-Year McGlynn School Solar Contract
items.summary: Referred to the regular meeting a request to authorize a 20-year solar power purchase agreement with Select Energy at the McGlynn School. Administration representatives explained that signing by year-end secures federal tax credits, while councilors raised questions about roof warranties and the financial comparison to direct city ownership.
